experiments.title: VIBES loading range — trace saved predictions
experiments.question: Which corrected-spectrum, fitted-coefficient, intercept and numerical-precision changes account for the saved VIBES versus AIRSpec prediction differences in the full-pool Q3 loading range?
experiments.readiness: Saved-model trace and 12-case spectral/solver investigation completed. Both methods severely underpredict the two leading cases; VIBES intensifies the negative predictions. All 12 fixed-parameter repeats converged; maximum prediction shift 0.002 µg/filter. A chemical cause is not established and no test-driven tuning/exclusions were made.

experiments.title: AIRSpec — reproduce the locked calibration
experiments.question: Can the saved R baseline comparison and the ftir_13 locked calibration be reproduced from frozen inputs, without selecting on Addis HIPS agreement?
experiments.readiness: Full unchanged ftir_13 runner reproduced in an isolated worktree. All five historical result tables pass 43 column checks at 1e-6; k=5 recovered, 606 training / 194 held-out OCEC rows, disjoint sites. The separate 319-scan R-port check also passed. No independent Addis thermal validation is implied.
experiments.dependency_reason: The completed reproduction consumes the fixed ftir_11 calibration cohort and compares against the saved ftir_13 output tables, with source/input hashes and column-level differences retained.

native_execution.result: Five historical tables plus six prior-local tables matched; all 84 column checks passed at absolute tolerance 1e-6.

experiments.title: Addis — independent thermal EC validation
experiments.question: How accurately do frozen FTIR EC predictions transfer to independent, identity-confirmed Addis thermal EC measurements?
